objective: Improve Mikrobat species classification accuracy of the frozen-encoder pipeline without training or fine-tuning the encoder.
primary_metric: Out-of-fold accuracy from grouped, stratified 5-fold cross-validation on the development pool (train + validation splits).
adoption_rule: Rungs are evaluated in the registered order, each applying its change to the best configuration adopted so far. A rung is adopted if its encoding time fits the latency budget and its out-of-fold accuracy is higher than the current best, or equal with a lower out-of-fold log-loss. Rungs over the latency budget are evaluated and reported but cannot be adopted. Validation, test and held-out results are reported for every rung and are never used to decide adoption.
latency_rationale: Interactive screening: encoding one uploaded image (all views) must take at most 3 s on the reference laptop CPU (AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS).

baseline.title: Baseline: ViT-S/14, 224 px, CLS token, single view
baseline.hypothesis: Reference point: the configuration shipped in the MVP.

ladder.title: Orientation augmentation and test-time averaging
ladder.hypothesis: Micrographs have no canonical orientation; training on all eight dihedral views and averaging them at inference removes orientation as a nuisance factor.

ladder.title: CLS + mean patch-token pooling
ladder.hypothesis: Patch tokens retain local cell-wall, crystal and trichome texture that the CLS summary discards.

ladder.title: Encoder resolution 308 px
ladder.hypothesis: Resizing the 300 px micrographs to 224 px discards fine structure; 308 px (22 x 22 patches) preserves it.

ladder.title: ViT-B/14 backbone
ladder.hypothesis: A larger frozen encoder (86M parameters) produces more separable embeddings.

ladder.title: ViT-L/14 backbone
ladder.hypothesis: The largest practical frozen encoder (304M parameters) improves separability further; measured benchmark cost suggests it exceeds the latency budget, so it establishes an accuracy reference rather than a production candidate.
